defaultStatus: No candidate is approved by default. Treat the current batch as blocked until one candidate is explicitly chosen by human review and then survives the follow-up loop rerender acceptance check.
shortlistDisclaimer: The shortlist is triage order only. It is not a recommendation, endorsement, or approval signal; every shortlisted candidate must still pass the same debris and identity checks as the rest of the batch.
rejectRule: Reject any candidate whose debris-focus sheet still shows detached rectangular scraps at the left edge, upper-right edge, or lower-right foreground.
acceptRule: Only promote a candidate if it is truly paper-free in those debris-focus zones and still preserves the approved creature identity, framing, and environment well enough to serve as the cleaned anchor.
postPickRule: After promotion + rerender, reopen the listed paper-money rerender report and reject the loop again unless both paper-like debris removal and seamless-loop acceptance pass.
